title: SOC 2 Evidence Collection Round
source_citation: AICPA SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria evidence-gathering pattern for a single audit period.

steps.title: Pull the quarterly access review
steps.instruction: Export the access review report and confirm every terminated user was removed within SLA.

steps.title: Sample change management tickets
steps.instruction: Select a sample of production changes and confirm each has an approval and a linked deployment record.

steps.title: Confirm vulnerability scan cadence
steps.instruction: Confirm scans ran on schedule for the period and high findings were remediated or risk-accepted.

steps.title: Confirm critical vendor reviews
steps.instruction: Confirm each critical subprocessor has a current SOC 2 or equivalent report on file.

steps.title: Package the evidence bundle
steps.instruction: Assemble the evidence set for the auditor and record the package hash for the audit trail.
